__meta_note__: Static VSI to OME-NGFF / OME-XML Metadata Mapping Dictionary for VSI OME-Zarr Converter

OME.Image.SizeX.explanation: Directly mapped to 5D Zarr array shape (dim X) and coordinate transformation scales.

OME.Image.SizeY.explanation: Directly mapped to 5D Zarr array shape (dim Y) and coordinate transformation scales.

OME.Image.SizeZ.explanation: Directly mapped to 5D Zarr array shape (dim Z).

OME.Image.SizeC.explanation: Mapped to OMERO channel metadata array length and 5D Zarr array shape (dim C).

OME.Image.SizeT.explanation: Directly mapped to 5D Zarr array shape (dim T).

OME.Image.PhysicalSizeX.explanation: Mapped via scientific dictionary: PhysicalSizeX ➔ multiscales coordinate scale factor (um/pixel).

OME.Image.PhysicalSizeY.explanation: Mapped via scientific dictionary: PhysicalSizeY ➔ multiscales coordinate scale factor (um/pixel).

OME.Image.PhysicalSizeZ.explanation: Mapped via scientific dictionary: PhysicalSizeZ ➔ multiscales coordinate scale factor (um/pixel).

ChannelName.explanation: Directly mapped to OMERO channel label attribute.

ChannelColor.explanation: Directly mapped to OMERO channel color attribute in Hex format.

VENDOR_GLOBAL.explanation: Statically mapped and preserved verbatim in vendor_custom_metadata attribute block.

VENDOR_SERIES.explanation: Statically mapped and preserved verbatim in vendor_custom_metadata attribute block.

OMEXMLHeader.explanation: Statically mapped to companion OME-XML metadata file for full bioformats2raw fidelity.
